blockers.detail: The twelve ordered per-step sparse identities are preserved, but their incidence sum/hash is not the unique final base-to-candidate uint8 diff required by v1.
The source preserves whole-archive bytes but no typed stream/layer/coder-owner foreign key; J5 coordinate sequence is not an EV2 seven-home allocation.
Only the final twelve-action composition has an n600 scorer transition, so the individually identity-complete applications cannot be emitted as measured rows.
Pipeline symbols and a source-coordinate checkpoint hash do not bind the exact application implementation bytes that built the candidate.
The archive and frozen scorer modules are SHA-bound, but the complete builder/parse-back/R receiver chain has no single implementation identity.
Producer must preserve the exact sparse uint8 index/value identity for this V19C_BASE -> one RG3 coordinate edge; candidate archive SHA is not a substitute.
Bind the exact PC1 apply/parse/receive implementation source SHA-256.
Bind the exact receiver/R implementation identity, not only its prose chain.
Preserve the final source->step16 sparse uint8 change count and identity.
Name one typed stream/layer home with coder owner and before/after bytes; whole-archive byte deltas alone do not identify the PC1 home.
